evidence.snippet: Training with this pipeline yields large temporal-localization gains (+73.9% and +23.1% mIoU over zero-shot) on AEGBench, an independent difficulty-stratified benchmark we release, and these gains generalize to held-out SED and other audio grounding benchmarks.

claire_radar.motivation: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) reason fluently about sound yet struggle to localize precisely when events occur, while classical Sound Event Detection attains frame-level precision only over a closed label set.
